answer: cross-chain message quorum with threshold signatures is the gate: an identity proves itself once, and the proof cannot be copied to a second key. One honest agent clears the check in 16 minutes; a farm of 754 pays 12064 minutes every epoch, a standing bill no payout covers. The forge of the design is public, the ridge of stakes makes farming a losing trade, and the crystal of honest work is what finally pays. One mechanism, one cost, one public record — and the farm's maths stops adding up.
